subject: Hospitality
title: Experience Over Content
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Experience Over Content.

hook.text: Content is free on YouTube. What events sell now isn't information—it's the experience of being there: energy, connection.

buildup.text: Events are shifting from lecture formats to immersive experiences: workshops, installations, tastings, and interactive challenges.

discovery.text: Meow Wolf's immersive art draws 2+ million visitors yearly. Event designers study them for experiential engagement ideas.

twist.text: Creating memorable experiences costs more than setting up chairs and a projector.

climax.text: The events that thrive are those that create moments that can't be streamed, downloaded, or replicated.

punchline.text: Content is free; presence is priceless. Events now sell what screens can never deliver.

quiz.question: Why are events shifting from content delivery to experience design?
options: Content is freely available online—events must offer irreplaceable in-person experiences
